visualizers.name: Mirror
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Spectrum bars mirrored around the middle line.

visualizers.name: Aurora
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Soft curtains of light that sway with the music.

visualizers.name: Shatter
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Shards bursting out of the centre on every beat.

visualizers.name: Nebula
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Glowing gas clouds that swell with the bass.

visualizers.name: Waves
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Layered waves riding on the spectrum.

visualizers.name: Tunnel
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Rings rushing towards you through a pulsing tunnel.

visualizers.name: Rings
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Concentric rings, one per band.

visualizers.name: Borealis
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Northern lights drifting across the sky.

visualizers.name: Ribbon
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A ribbon twisting through the spectrum.

visualizers.name: Mist
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Slow fog that brightens with the music.

visualizers.name: Cascade
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Falling streams of light per band.

visualizers.name: Horizon
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A glowing horizon line with a reflected spectrum.

visualizers.name: Starfield
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Warp flight: stars stream out of the centre, the bass stretches them into streaks.

visualizers.name: Kaleido
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: The spectrum as one jagged petal, mirrored eight times around the centre.

visualizers.name: Fireflies
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Drifting lights, each glowing with its own frequency band.

visualizers.name: Lissajous
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Oscilloscope figure: mids and highs set the ratio, the bass its size.

visualizers.name: Skyline
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A night city whose windows light up with the music, under a pulsing moon.

visualizers.name: Pendulum Wave
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Pendulums of slowly differing lengths drift in and out of phase; each swings wider with its band.

visualizers.name: Sonar
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A radar sweep finds every band as a contact; loud ones close in on the centre.

visualizers.name: Ink Drops
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Beats drop ink into water, spreading in ragged rings and dissolving.

visualizers.name: DNA Helix
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A turning double helix whose rungs light up with the bands; the bass twists it.

visualizers.name: Orbitals
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A small solar system: the sun breathes with the bass, eight planets race with their bands.

visualizers.name: Seismograph
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A pen scratches bass and energy onto rolling paper; beats shake the needle.

visualizers.name: Rainfall
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Rain over a dark pond, heavier with the music, slanted by bass gusts.

visualizers.name: Flip Tiles
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A departure board of tiles flipping over as the bands rise and fall.

visualizers.name: Heartbeat
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: An ECG monitor: every bass beat is a heartbeat, with the tempo as pulse.

visualizers.name: Dunes
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Layers of desert dunes at dusk, each shaped by another part of the spectrum.

visualizers.name: Clockwork
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Five meshed gears driven by the music, their teeth stretching with the bands.

visualizers.name: Jellyfish
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A glowing jellyfish pulses upward on the bass, tentacles waving with the mids.

visualizers.name: Iso City
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: An isometric block of towers rising and falling with 64 bands.

visualizers.name: Bloom
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A flower of three petal rings opening with bass, mids and highs.

visualizers.name: Lightning
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A storm: strong beats strike forked bolts that light up the sky.

visualizers.name: Glyph Rain
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Columns of falling glyphs, each column faster the louder its band.

visualizers.name: Spirograph
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A spirograph pen draws endless loops; the music changes gear and pen.

visualizers.name: Pulsar
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Stacked spectra like the famous pulsar plot, newest in front.

visualizers.name: Bubbles
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Bubbles rise from their band, as big as it is loud, and pop at the top.

visualizers.name: Vinyl
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A spinning record whose grooves light up with the bands, tone arm included.

visualizers.name: Fireworks
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Beats launch rockets that burst into falling, sparkling sparks.

visualizers.name: Ripples
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Peaks drop stones into still water at eight spots; the rings overlap and fade.

visualizers.name: Constellation
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Stars shine with their bands and join into star signs when they shine together.

visualizers.name: Synthwave
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: An 80s sunset: striped sun, spectrum mountains and a neon grid rushing at you.

visualizers.name: Outrun
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Night drive into a striped sunset: a neon road, palm trees flying by, faster with the music.

visualizers.name: Miami
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Palm silhouettes in front of a sinking sun, its reflection rippling on the water with the spectrum.

visualizers.name: Vaporwave
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Pink and teal dusk over a grid floor; a wireframe pyramid spins and swells with the bass.

visualizers.name: Terrain
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A neon wireframe landscape you fly over; every new ridge is the spectrum of the moment.

visualizers.name: Neon Tunnel
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Square neon frames racing towards you down a twisting retro tunnel.

visualizers.name: Lasers
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A club laser show: beams fan out from the stage and sweep with the beat through the haze.

visualizers.name: Light Cycles
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Light cycles race over a neon grid, turning on the beats and leaving glowing walls behind.

visualizers.name: VHS
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Spectrum bars on an old tape: colour fringes, scanlines and tracking noise when the bass hits.

visualizers.name: Warp
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A spectrum ring that keeps zooming out of the centre and twisting, like a MilkDrop feedback loop.

visualizers.name: Black Hole
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A black hole with a swirling accretion disk; the bass feeds it and the disk flares up.

visualizers.name: Galaxy
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A spiral galaxy turning slowly; its arms sparkle with the bands, the core glows with the bass.

visualizers.name: Tesseract
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A four-dimensional cube turning through itself; the bass pushes the inner cube out.

visualizers.name: Radial
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Spectrum bars arranged in a circle around a core that beats with the bass.

visualizers.name: Disco
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A spinning mirror ball throwing light spots across the room, brighter on the beat.

visualizers.name: Amplifier
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Two backlit analogue VU meters of an old hi-fi amp; the needles kick with bass and treble.

visualizers.name: Cassette
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A mixtape playing: the reels spin with the energy, a little spectrum glows in the label window.

visualizers.name: Invaders
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Pixel invaders march in formation, each column lit and bouncing with its band.

visualizers.name: Copper Bars
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Amiga-style raster bars swinging on sine waves, one bar per part of the spectrum.

visualizers.name: Pixel Fire
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: The old demoscene fire: chunky pixel flames fed from below by the spectrum.

visualizers.name: Lava Lamp
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Warm blobs rising and melting into each other in a lava lamp, driven by the bass.

visualizers.name: Fractal Tree
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A glowing tree that grows with the bass and spreads its branches with the mids and highs.

visualizers.name: Mandala
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Layers of petals and dots unfolding in rotational symmetry, each layer on its own band.

visualizers.name: Peak Meter
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A segmented LED spectrum analyser with falling peak caps, like on a stereo rack.

visualizers.name: Spectrogram
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A scrolling heat map of the spectrum: bass at the bottom, time running to the left.

visualizers.name: Alchemy
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Rotating nested polygons with glowing, hue-cycling edges, after the Windows Media Player classic.

visualizers.name: Battery
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A wall of energy cells lighting up column by column, green at the bottom to red at the top.

visualizers.name: Plasma
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A soft plasma field stirred by bass, mids and highs, with a glowing scope on top.

visualizers.name: Sparks
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Coloured sparks flung around the centre by the spectrum peaks.

visualizers.name: Vortex
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Four spiral arms whirling out of the centre, faster with the bass.

visualizers.name: Helix
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Two glowing strands winding down the screen, swinging wider with their bands.

visualizers.name: Scope
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: An oscilloscope trace of the spectrum with a phase-shifted second wave.

visualizers.name: Grid Pulse
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: A grid of cells that swell and glow in a diagonal wave across the spectrum.

visualizers.name: Bars
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: Classic spectrum bars rising from the middle line over a faint reflection.

visualizers.name: Dots
visualizers.author: parrotify
visualizers.description: One glowing dot per band, floating as high and as big as the band is loud.
